title: Upgradables
description: Adds Upgrades For Each Tier Of Tools
body:
# Upgradables

Upgradables reworks Minecraft's gear progression by turning every tool and armor piece into a long-term investment.

Instead of crafting a completely new set every time you reach a higher tier, you upgrade your existing equipment through the Smithing Table using special Upgrade Templates found throughout the world.

## Tool Progression

Wood → Stone → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond

## Armor Progression

Leather → Chainmail → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond

Every upgrade after the first tier requires a Smithing Table and the corresponding Upgrade Template.

## Upgrade Template Locations

### Stone Upgrade

* Found in Plains Village chests
* Common loot
* Not guaranteed
* Dropped by Villagers

### Copper Upgrade

* Found in Trial Chamber Vault rewards
* Not guaranteed
* Dropped by Boggeds

### Iron Upgrade

* Found in Pillager Outpost chests
* Guaranteed
* Dropped by Pillagers

### Gold Upgrade

* Found in Mineshaft Minecart chests (excluding Badlands Mineshafts)
* Guaranteed
* Dropped by Cave Spiders

### Diamond Upgrade

* Found in Ancient City chests
* Guaranteed
* Dropped by Wardens

## Features

* Gives Wooden Tools a purpose beyond the first few minutes of the game
* Makes Leather Armor worth collecting
* Adds Copper as a full progression tier
* Adds Use for Gold
* Encourages exploration of structures throughout the world
* Creates a slower and more rewarding progression system
* Vanilla-friendly gameplay with no overpowered equipment

Upgrade your gear, explore the world, and make every tool and armor piece part of your journey.
